content.text:
Completed the read-only inventory of all 36 top-level `*fn` products.

- Required admin UI: 21
- Useful or conditional: 6
- No standalone admin UI: 9

Only CiFn has a substantive dashboard. CmsFn Studio is a scaffold, WatchFn is a hard-coded prototype, AuthFn has admin routes only, and ApiFn has embedded explorer components rather than an admin console.

Recommended architecture: one shared Superfunctions Console with modular product surfaces. CatchFn and LogFn belong inside WatchFn; ContentFn belongs inside CmsFn; McpFn should remain inspector/host-owned. Full row-by-row classifications, equivalents, operator objects, current state, and evidence were sent to the parent agent.
